name: find-url
description: Video URLs from a site search, a playlist, or a channel, through yt-dlp. Never cached.

verbs.name: search
verbs.description: Top video results for search words, in the site's order. Prints one URL per line, or the URL list with --json.

words.description: Search words, quoted as one argument.

site.description: yt-dlp search prefix, such as ytsearch for YouTube or scsearch for SoundCloud.

verbs.name: list
verbs.description: Every video of a playlist or channel URL, in the site's order. Prints one URL per line, or the URL list with --json.

url.description: Playlist or channel page URL on any site yt-dlp supports.

verbs.name: parse
verbs.description: URL list from a yt-dlp info JSON file already on disk, as yt-dlp -J --flat-playlist writes it.

path.description: A yt-dlp flat playlist info JSON file.
